name: mixed-provider-pipeline
description: Demonstrates per-step agent provider selection: the research step runs on the default Copilot provider while the drafting step is routed to OpenCode. Each provider gets its own per-run worker pool; the engine opens one run scope per provider used.

steps.name: research
steps.systemPrompt: You are a research assistant. Produce a tight, factual brief.
steps.userPrompt: Research the topic: {{param.topic}} and list the key points.

steps.name: draft
steps.userPrompt: Write a short article about {{param.topic}} using the research above.

topic.description: The topic to research and write about
